summary: Phase 1 formatos de impresión editor tested end-to-end. Backend CRUD (list/create/update/delete + 404) all PASS. Regressions (hoja-entrada.html, ajustes modulo_inicio) PASS. Frontend: editor loads at /ajustes/formatos, builtin 'Recepción de Vehículo' auto-created, template selector works, new template persists across reload (DB persistence confirmed), rename debounced auto-save works, palette add-text adds element to canvas, fill mode toggles palette/props off and typing into field input works (86 inputs rendered, value persisted), fmt-print calls window.print(), Ajustes card + navigate button work.

issues: Two 'Recepción de Vehículo' entries appear in the selector (builtin was created twice historically — likely from a prior race when list was empty on concurrent loads, or from earlier test runs). Consider deduping by name or seeding only once via a marker doc.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid to canvas elements (e.g. data-testid=fmt-el-{id}) to enable robust element-level UI automation.
(Optional) Prevent duplicate builtin 'Recepción de Vehículo' creation — check by name before seeding.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints look clean, use dict projection to exclude _id, and return updated docs after PUT.
FormatoInput allows any dict shape for elements — acceptable for Phase 1 but consider stricter schema later.
Fill-mode inputs render as <input> with no explicit type attr; works but 'input[type="text"]' CSS selectors won't match — cosmetic.
test_credentials: License auto-configured via REACT_APP_LICENSE_KEY=NEXO-DEMO-0001; no auth needed for /api/formatos.
seed_data_creation: Test template 'TEST_Formato' created and deleted by pytest. One 'Formato 3' new template was created via UI during persistence test and left behind (can be cleaned via DELETE /api/formatos/{id}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 backend tests pass. Frontend editor + fill mode confirmed. Canvas child elements do not carry per-element data-testid — use '[style*="position: absolute"]' or 'input' selectors instead. Two duplicate 'Recepción' rows exist from prior seeding — may need cleanup script.
